name: Loving Your Wife
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is God-ordained, beginning with the creation of a suitable helper for the man to fulfill the design of unity and companionship (Genesis 2:18, 24). A wife is portrayed as a virtuous and invaluable gift, whose worth surpasses precious jewels (Proverbs 31:10). The New Testament calls husbands to love their wives sacrificially, as Christ loved the church, demonstrating a self-giving love that reflects the gospel (Ephesians 5:25). This love is to be expressed within a mutual submission rooted in reverence for God, where both husband and wife honor their roles in the marriage relationship (Ephesians 5:21-22).
